attractions.name: Mullayanagiri Peak
attractions.description: Highest peak in Karnataka with sweeping views of misty rolling hills and green ridges; the final stretch involves a short climb.
tips: Misty mornings give a dreamlike atmosphere and clear days give endless ridge views
Trek sandals optional for the outdoor terrain
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx

attractions.name: Hebbe Waterfalls
attractions.description: Powerful cascade hidden deep within coffee estates, reached by a rugged jeep ride through forest trails.
attractions.dress_code: Comfortable footwear recommended; terrain near the falls is slippery
tips: Jeep access is mandatory; self-drive cars cannot reach the falls
Roads can be rough; plan buffer time
attractions._source_file: Karnataka, Kerala and Tamil Nadu/Pratheek_Karnataka_All Inclusive Guide.docx
